'''Te Hasa''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a Type II [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was located within the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A hidden planet that had been [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] into a harsh desert world with [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] predators, Te Hasa was used for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to store many pieces of ancient [[Gree technology]] that the [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] species had forgotten how to use.

The Te Hasan Gree dedicated themselves to rediscovering ways of operating the ancient devices stored in the numerous vaults and warehouses located on the planet, such as the [[Great Library of Manuals]], with many Gree making pilgrimages to Te Hasa in order to study the technological knowledge. Several guilds of [[Master (Gree)|masters]]&mdash;members of the Gree [[operator]] caste who specialized in the use of various technologies&mdash;were present on the desert planet, while a group of Gree from Te Hasa also oversaw the [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] of artifacts on the planet [[Asation]].

==Description==
Te Hasa was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TGE" /> that was located in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] region's [[Te Hasa system/Legends|Te Hasa system]], within the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet was connected to the world of [[Malanose]] via a relatively poorly-known [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The [[Rokak'k Baran]], a massive [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] equipped with a Class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that was the main method of travel within the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] Enclave, took two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to travel the route and made regular, two-day-long visits to Te Hasa.<ref name="TGE" />

The planet was also the destination point of at least one [[hypergate]]&mdash;a device allowing instantaneous transportation between two points&mdash;based on the planet [[Asation]]. Although the gate was non-functional by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], its use had been common before the civilization of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Gree [[Species/Legends|species]] declined.<ref name="TGE" />

Te Hasa was a dry [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world with a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The [[Local day/Legends|local day]] lasted twenty-nine [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], while a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] encompassed 296 days. Te Hasa had a Type II [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], which was comfortable for the Gree who had settled there, although [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] were suggested for certain other species.<ref name="TGE" />

Although Te Hasa already had deserts, rocky valleys, and canyons on its surface, the Gree [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the planet to be truly formidable to any [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] who might discover the dry world. The deserts were greatly expanded by routing Te Hasa's [[Water/Legends|water]] to underground cisterns that were located under oases in the valleys. Water was also transported to other Gree worlds. As an additional precaution, the Gree [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] the native predators to be more aggressive and [[Death/Legends|deadly]], while other creatures were engineered to sustain the [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]].<ref name="TGE" />

==History==
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the Galactic Civil War, members of the Gree species settled Te Hasa.<ref name="TGE" />

{{RPGseed}}
During that conflict, an expedition of Gree from Te Hasa traveled to the planet Asation to find and retrieve the ancient [[Khoz'zhak]] device. The Te Hasans pursued the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]], who had discovered the artifact in the Asation jungle, and eventually bought the Khoz'zhak from a group of [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] who were working together with Antilles.<ref name="TGE" />
{{Endgame}}

A few years later,<ref name="Files">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Date">"[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which mentions the [[Thief/Legends|theft]] of the [[Sharka'k Noor]] by [[Ils Ee]], is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which is dated to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Gree [[Master (Gree)|master]] [[Sharka'k]], whose collection of Gree devices included the artifact known as the [[Sharka'k Noor]], died on Asation. Since Sharka'k had not passed on the knowledge of operating the Noor to any apprentice, the Te Hasan Gree claimed the artifact. However, before the latter could retrieve the Noor, it was stolen by [[Doctor]] [[Ils Ee]], who then escaped from the Gree Enclave.<ref name="Files" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Gree-AlienEncounters.png|thumb|right|200px|The Gree species used Te Hasa to store ancient devices and technological knowledge.]]
Home to 10,000 members of the sentient Gree species, Te Hasa was a legendary, secret world that the [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopoids]] used for thousands of years to house ancient [[Gree technology|technological]] knowledge and hundreds of unique devices. The artifacts, which the Gree had forgotten how to operate by the time of the Galactic Civil War, were stored and cataloged in warehouses in the hope of eventually rediscovering their use.<ref name="TGE" />

Dozens of Gree made a pilgrimage to Te Hasa each year in order to study the deposited technology, and occasionally some of them accidentally discovered the correct activation sequences for some of the devices or managed to decrypt the relevant instructions from the [[Great Library of Manuals]], an expansive vault of technical knowledge. Such individuals were then granted the rank of master&mdash;a member of the Gree [[operator]] caste who was proficient in using a piece of the ancient technology. Those Gree who figured out how to operate some of the stored artifacts could keep those devices themselves, for the Te Hasan vaults contained duplicates, and the local Gree were only interested in the knowledge, not the devices themselves.<ref name="TGE" />

The Gree from Te Hasa were close in function to [[Priest/Legends|priesthood]] and wore dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Robe/Legends|robes]] ornamented with hieroglyphs. Those who made pilgrimages to the desert world wore traditional bright robes and were [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] to signify that they studied there. The Te Hasans,<ref name="TGE" /> also known as the [[Keepers of Artifacts]],<ref name="Files" /> were a closely-knit community who guarded their technology with great care but were ready to accept the help of other Gree in rediscovering its use. A contingent of Te Hasan Gree also oversaw the trade of artifacts on the world of Asation and was allowed to interfere with the trade of advanced technology.<ref name="TGE" />

Te Hasa was governed by a guild of Gree [[Librarian/Legends|librarians]], but members of other guilds were also present. The largest number of [[textmaster]]s&mdash;specialists of information systems and communications devices&mdash;in the Gree Enclave worked in the Great Library of Manuals, and master [[synthesor]]s, who had the skill of operating matter reconfiguration devices, were also common on Te Hasa.<ref name="TGE" />

==Locations==
Te Hasa was the location of the Great Library of Manuals, where only knowledge focusing on technology was accessible to the Gree, as well as storehouses in or near oases in the valleys. The older warehouses were carved into rock, while newer ones, constructed like longhouses, resembled temples rising above the planet's surface.<ref name="TGE" />

Deep in Te Hasa's largest desert, ''[[Sik'ark'kuck]]''&mdash;which meant "the Swallower" in the [[Gree (language)|Gree language]]&mdash;the Gree stored the most valuable or dangerous artifacts in a restricted and secret warehouse. A landing field was also present on the planet.<ref name="TGE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Te Hasa was introduced in "[[The Gree Enclave]]," an article written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]] in [[November]] [[1995]]. ''The Gree Enclave'' includes an adventure seed for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', and this article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="TGE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Te Hasa [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square K-2.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
